segments.text: We first tried E-commerce platform in 206. At the time, competition mattered because competitors moved online and took some market share.
The biggest issue was Cybersecurity concerns. Without steady power in Maiduguri, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after E-commerce platform—we saw Sales increase within 5 months.
Policy-wise, CBN cashless policy shaped our move. We adjusted by Staff training.
Data helped; even a moving-average model gave us clearer demand patterns during Easter.
